rationale: H1 and H3 both surviving means neither has been eliminated by the comparison. It does not establish their shared premise that an irregularity occurred, and other explanations may also survive. The mapping explicitly warns that surviving contradiction is not proof of truth.
signal_basis: The observable is the filled matrix: a comparative pattern showing which hypotheses accumulate inconsistent items, which items discriminate, and which conclusions shift under the sensitivity test. It is not any single document.
